_comment_ConnectionStrings: Development placeholder. Override via ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection env var in all non-local environments.

Tenancy._comment: ResolveFrom: 'host' = subdomain (foo.example.com), 'header' = X-Tenant header, 'jwt' = JWT claim. Default chain: jwt then host.

_comment_Devices: Development placeholder. Override via DEVICE_MASTER_KEY in all non-local environments. Root of every device credential.
_comment_RateLimits: Per-IP, per-minute ceilings. Deployment infrastructure rather than club policy, so these live here and not in tenant_settings: the limiter partitions by remote address, which is not a tenant-scoped quantity.
_comment_Discovery: UDP board-discovery listener. Deployment infrastructure, not club policy, so it lives here rather than in tenant_settings: the listener binds before any request exists (so there is no tenant to read a setting from), the boards it hears belong to no tenant yet, and the ceilings bound an unauthenticated UDP socket. Port 48653 is fixed by the wire protocol; AdvertisedBaseUrl left empty means the OFFER carries the address of whichever local interface can reach the board. Requires host networking - see docker-compose.onprem.yml.
_comment_Webhooks: SSRF guard. AllowPrivateNetworks disables it wholesale and defaults to true only in Development. PrivateNetworkAllowList is the carve-out CLAUDE.md requires for the lights controller: CIDRs, so a /32 admits one board rather than the whole private internet.
